how_to_apply: Candidates can apply online for KFD Forest Observer Recruitment 2026 through the official Karnataka Forest Department website. The steps below are based on the application instructions in the notification.
Visit the official website of the Karnataka Forest Department: https://aranya.gov.in/.
Open the "Nemakati" (Recruitment) section at the bottom of the home page, where the notification is published.
Read the notification, the instructions and the Karnataka Forest Department Services (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules 2019 carefully, and confirm that you meet the eligibility conditions.
Fill in the online application with the required details, using your own Aadhaar (UID) number.
Scan and upload the required certificates, such as the SSLC marks card, the caste certificate and the reservation certificates, as applicable.
Submit the application and pay the application fee online (UPI, NEFT, credit card, debit card or internet banking) or by cash challan at the notified bank branches.
Take a printout of the submitted online application and the fee receipt and keep them for future reference. Do not send a hard copy to the department.
The last date to apply online is 30.10.2026. Candidates should apply well before the deadline.
important_instructions: Apply only through the online mode. Applications by post, courier, e-mail, hand or any other mode are not accepted. Fee payment by demand draft, cheque or postal order is not accepted. Read the instructions and the Karnataka Forest Department Services (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules 2019 carefully before applying. Once an application is submitted, changes or corrections are not allowed. A candidate must use only his or her own Aadhaar (UID) number. If a candidate has applied using another person's Aadhaar number, the application is rejected and the candidate is debarred from the department's recruitment for 10 years. Take a printout of the submitted online application and the fee payment receipt and keep them. A hard copy does not have to be sent to the department. The printout must be carried along with the hall ticket for the tests. Keep the mobile number and e-mail ID given in the application active until the recruitment process is completed. Candidates who are in service with the Central or State Government or a public sector undertaking need to obtain a no-objection certificate before appointment. Candidates dismissed from service of the Central or State Government, a Government-owned body or a local authority are not eligible. A candidate who is a member of, or in close association with, an organisation declared unlawful is not eligible. A candidate who has been involved in anti-social activities and found guilty is also not eligible. A candidate who is debarred from any examination or recruitment of the Central or State Government or a Government body, temporarily or permanently, is not eligible. If a candidate is found to be impersonating someone else, submitting forged or tampered documents, giving false statements, hiding facts, or using unfair means, the candidature is cancelled, and the candidate may face criminal and disciplinary action and a 10-year debarment from the department's recruitment. Any attempt to bring outside pressure on the recruiting authority results in cancellation of candidature. If a candidate does not attend the recruitment process on the dates notified, the candidature is cancelled automatically. The recruiting authority may change the number of posts or the reservation classification if needed. Any change is published on aranya.gov.in under "Nemakati" (Recruitment). The authority also has the power to revise the list in case of a court order, Government direction or circular. The decision of the recruiting authority is final, and all legal disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the Karnataka State judiciary.

content_sections.heading: KFD Forest Observer Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The application period for KFD Forest Observer Recruitment 2026 has been extended more than once. The latest extension letter, dated 29.09.2026, extends the online application deadline to 30.10.2026. The first extension (01.09.2026 to 07.09.2026) was made for technical reasons, and the extension up to 30.09.2026 was directed in a meeting held on 04.09.2026 under the chairmanship of the Hon'ble Minister for Forest, Ecology and Environment. The latest extension to 30.10.2026 follows Government notification No. FEE 242 FNG 2026 dated 23.09.2026, which proposes to include some Scheduled Tribe sub-castes under the Scheduled Tribe – Local Forest Dwelling Tribes reservation. A draft notification amending the Forest Guard and Forest Watcher cadre and recruitment rules was published in the Karnataka Gazette (Extraordinary), inviting objections and suggestions.

content_sections.heading: KFD Forest Observer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: KFD Forest Observer Vacancy 2026 stands at 750 posts. Of these, 700 are in the original cadre (Non-HK) and 50 are in the Kalyana Karnataka (HK) region. The posts are spread across 13 circles, and the circle-wise numbers are given below. The notification also lists vacancies for each division, wildlife unit and research or working plan circle. The unit names below are English renderings of the Kannada names in the notification. The vacancies are filled as per the Karnataka Forest Department Services (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules 2019 (Government notification No. FEE 203 FEG 2015 dated 06.08.2019) and the reservation rules in force. The category-wise reservation breakup of the 750 posts is not given in the provided documents, because the circle-level notification format is left blank for each circle to fill. The PCCF letter states that, because of the interim order of the Hon'ble High Court, the Scheduled Caste reservation has been temporarily limited from 17% to 15%. The 400-point roster issued by the Social Welfare Department (Government order No. SAKA 515 PAKAVI 2026 dated 08.05.2026) is to be followed. In the circles of Bengaluru, Chamarajanagar, Chikkamagaluru, Kanara, Kodagu, Mangaluru, Mysuru and Shivamogga, 50% of the Forest Observer posts in the notified wildlife divisions and tiger reserves are reserved for Local Forest Dwelling Tribes candidates (see the reservation section below). The PCCF letter dated 30.06.2026 refers to 25 backlog posts left unfilled from an earlier direct recruitment (310 Forest Watcher posts), taking the total to 775 (750 vacancies + 25 backlog). The backlog table in the provided PDF is rotated and not clearly legible, and the circle-level notification format and the extension letter refer to the 750 vacancies. This article therefore uses 750 as the vacancy figure.

content_sections.heading: KFD Forest Observer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To be eligible for KFD Forest Observer Recruitment 2026, candidates must meet all the conditions below, along with the qualification and age limit given in the next sections. The candidate must be a citizen of India. A male candidate with more than one living wife, or a female candidate married to a man who already has a wife, is not eligible for appointment without prior permission of the Government. The candidate must be mentally and physically healthy and free from any physical defect likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties. The candidate must meet the physical standards and pass the physical endurance and physical efficiency tests described below. The recruiting authority may reject a candidate as physically unfit on the advice of a medical board, and the Government's discretion is not limited by these rules. Applying online does not by itself make a candidate eligible for appointment. A candidate is considered to have accepted all the Acts, rules and regulations of the Government on applying.

content_sections.heading: KFD Forest Observer Qualification
content_sections.text: The educational qualification for KFD Forest Observer is SSLC. The candidate must hold the SSLC examination conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board, or an equivalent qualification, on the last date to apply. As per Government circular No. CASUE 81 SENENI 2017 dated 27.02.2018, the following are treated as equivalent to SSLC: Class 10 examination conducted by CBSE and ICSE boards, or Class 10 examination conducted by other State Government examination boards, or Secondary-level course conducted by the National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS), or Secondary-level course conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board (KOS). Candidates who have not received the result of the prescribed qualification, or who do not hold the marks card, as on the last date to apply are not eligible. No other qualification is considered in place of the above. If a candidate is found to lack the prescribed qualification at any stage, the candidature is cancelled, and the decision of the recruiting authority is final.

content_sections.heading: KFD Forest Observer Reservation Details
content_sections.text: Reservation is applied as per the Karnataka Civil Services (Direct Recruitment) (General) Rules 2021 and the Karnataka Forest Department Services (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules 2019. The notification includes the following reservation provisions. Caste and category reservation: Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Category-I, IIA, IIB, IIIA and IIIB. Certificates must be in the prescribed formats: Form D for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe, Form E for Category-I, and Form F for Category IIA, IIB, IIIA and IIIB, obtained from the Tahsildar and valid on the last date to apply. Backward class certificates are valid for 5 years. Ex-servicemen: Candidates with the prescribed discharge and no-objection documents. BSF, CRPF and CISF personnel are not treated as ex-servicemen. Persons with disabilities: For this post (Forest Watcher – Group D), only the categories LC (Leprosy Cured), AAV (Acid Attack Victims) and MI (Mental Illness) are eligible under the disability reservation, as per Government notification No. WCD 111 PHP 2022 dated 19.08.2023. Candidates must have at least 40% disability and must not have any other disability. Project-displaced families: Candidates from families displaced by projects, with the prescribed Tahsildar certificate (Form-3). Families displaced more than 25 years before the date of the rules do not qualify. Kannada medium: Candidates who studied from Class 1 to Class 10 in Kannada medium, with the prescribed certificate. Rural candidates: Candidates who studied from Class 1 to Class 10 in a rural area, with the Form-2 certificate. General candidates claiming rural reservation must also have Form-1 (non-creamy layer) and Form-2. Candidates of reserved categories whose caste certificate is rejected and who lack a Non-Creamy Layer certificate are not eligible for rural reservation. Third gender candidates: A certificate issued by the District Magistrate under the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Rules 2020. Local Forest Dwelling Tribes (ST-LFDT): Fifty percent of the vacancies in the following wildlife divisions and tiger reserves are filled from local forest dwelling Scheduled Tribe candidates: Bandipur Tiger Reserve; Nagarahole Tiger Reserve; BRT Tiger Reserve, Chamarajanagar; Cauvery Wildlife Division, Kanakapura; Bhadra Tiger Reserve, Chikkamagaluru; Kudremukh Wildlife Division, Karkala; Madikeri Wildlife Division, Madikeri; MM Hills Wildlife Division, Kollegal; Bannerughatta Wildlife Division, Bengaluru; Kali Tiger Reserve, Dandeli; and Shivamogga Wildlife Division, Shivamogga. The tribes named for this reservation are Jenu Kuruba, Kadu Kuruba, Hakkipikki, Soliga, Soligaru, Yerava, Gowdlu, Irular, Iruliga, Koraga, Melakudi, Malaikudi, Maleru, Meda and Thoda. The candidate must have studied from Class 1 to Class 12 for one or more years in the taluks where the Wildlife Division or Tiger Reserve is located. content_sections.heading: Documents Required for KFD Forest Observer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: All certificates must be uploaded with the online application. Candidates who claim a reservation but do not upload the prescribed certificate are not considered for that reservation. The documents uploaded at the time of application are the only ones considered at all stages and cannot be changed later. SSLC or equivalent marks card, as proof of date of birth (Class 10 marks card of the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board, CBSE or ICSE) Marks cards relating to the educational qualification Caste certificate (Form D, E or F as applicable) for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and backward class candidates Certificates for ex-servicemen, persons with disabilities, project-displaced families, Kannada medium, rural, third gender and ST-LFDT claims, as applicable Aadhaar (UID) number of the candidate During document verification, candidates must produce the original documents of everything uploaded. If any extra or different document is submitted, it is not considered, and a candidate who fails to submit the documents mentioned in the application by the notified date or does not attend is rejected.

content_sections.heading: Training, Probation and Posting
content_sections.text: After appointment as a Forest Observer, the candidate must serve in the department for at least 3 years from the date of appointment. Otherwise, the full cost of training must be paid to the Government as per the prescribed norms. The candidate must execute a bond on Rs. 100 stamp paper, agreeing to serve at any place in Karnataka State specified by the Government. Candidates who successfully complete the induction training are posted as per the Karnataka State Civil Services (Regulation of Transfers of Officers and Staff) Act 2016 and the 2019 rules. Physical tests for all notified circles are conducted at the same time.

A candidate who is a member of, or in close association with, an organisation declared unlawful is not eligible. A candidate who has been involved in anti-social activities and found guilty is also not eligible. A candidate who is debarred from any examination or recruitment of the Central or State Government or a Government body, temporarily or permanently, is not eligible. If a candidate is found to be impersonating someone else, submitting forged or tampered documents, giving false statements, hiding facts, or using unfair means, the candidature is cancelled, and the candidate may face criminal and disciplinary action and a 10-year debarment from the department's recruitment. Any attempt to bring outside pressure on the recruiting authority results in cancellation of candidature. If a candidate does not attend the recruitment process on the dates notified, the candidature is cancelled automatically. The recruiting authority may change the number of posts or the reservation classification if needed. Any change is published on aranya.gov.in under "Nemakati" (Recruitment). The authority also has the power to revise the list in case of a court order, Government direction or circular. The decision of the recruiting authority is final, and all legal disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the Karnataka State judiciary.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KFD Forest Observer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply online for KFD Forest Observer Recruitment 2026 through the official Karnataka Forest Department website. The steps below are based on the application instructions in the notification. Visit the official website of the Karnataka Forest Department: https://aranya.gov.in/. Open the "Nemakati" (Recruitment) section at the bottom of the home page, where the notification is published. Read the notification, the instructions and the Karnataka Forest Department Services (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules 2019 carefully, and confirm that you meet the eligibility conditions. Fill in the online application with the required details, using your own Aadhaar (UID) number. Scan and upload the required certificates, such as the SSLC marks card, the caste certificate and the reservation certificates, as applicable. Submit the application and pay the application fee online (UPI, NEFT, credit card, debit card or internet banking) or by cash challan at the notified bank branches. Take a printout of the submitted online application and the fee receipt and keep them for future reference. Do not send a hard copy to the department. The last date to apply online is 30.10.2026. Candidates should apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 750 vacancies available for the Forest Watcher position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSLC or an equivalent examination from a recognized board to be eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age goes up to 33 years depending on the category of the candidate.

faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary structured in the pay scale of Rs. 27500 - 46675 per month.

faq.answer: The online application process starts on 1 August 2026 and concludes on 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for general category male candidates?
faq.answer: Male candidates belonging to General, Cat-2A, 2B, 3A, and 3B categories are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 200/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for KFD Forest Watcher?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Physical Standard Test (PST), Physical Endurance Test (PET), Physical Efficiency Test (PET), document verification, and a medical examination.
